rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0001
rows.name:
In the middle of battle, a companion
suddenly goes down...

rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0002
rows.name:
If you find yourself in that
situation, go to that person's side
and offer a hand.

rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0003
rows.name:
If everyone's morale is high, you
should be able to help your companion
back up.

rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Of course, if morale has broken, you
won't be able to help.

rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0005
rows.name:
A companion just helped back up won't
be at full strength. Keep offering
support to prevent another fall.

rows.label: tlk70000073_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Helping each other is what matters.
With companions at your side, I
believe you can overcome any hardship!
